item.title: backnotprop/plannotator — 업무 공간에서 최신 정보를 파악하고 에이전트를 관리하세요. 클릭 한 번으로 코드를 작성하고, 결정하고, 계획하고, 주석을 달고, 검토하고, 팀과 공유하고, 모든 피드백을 에이전트에 전송할 수 있습니다.

요약

  • 에이전트가 결정, 계획, HTML을 제안하거나 작업을 완료하면 앱이 브라우저에서 열리고 사용자가 이를 마크업하고, 의견을 달고, 에이전트가 조치를 취할 수 있도록 피드백을 직접 전송합니다.

The workspace to stay in the loop and on top of agents - shape, decide, plan, annotate, review code, share with team, and send all feedback to agents with one click.

본문

Everything you need to annotate and stay in the loop with your agents Inbox Surface • Artifacts • Code Review Annotate plans, specs, markdown, HTML, and other interactive artifacts. Review diffs and PRs. Send feedback to your agent.

Plannotator Inbox · Official site · Code Review · Visual HTML Skills · Herdr Annotate · (Legacy) Plan Mode

⭐️ NEW: Plannotator Inbox is the missing review layer between you and multi-agent work. It surfaces decisions, prototypes, variations, plans, and everything you need to stay in the loop. Works with all coding agents and personal assistants.

Plannotator is a local, browser-based review surface for AI coding agents: Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Kiro, Droid, Amp, DeepSeek Harness, and Pi. Plannotator Inbox also works with personal assistants (Grok Bot, Muse, Hermes, OpenClaw).

It plugs directly into your agent through plugins, hooks and commands. When the agent proposes a decision, plan, html, or finishes working, the app opens in your browser and you mark it up, comment, and send feedback directly to the agent for it to act on it.

Annotate plans, specs, messages, html, then send the feedback to your agent.

Review local changes or remote PRs. Comment on diffs, suggest code. Your comments go back to the agent. Works with Git, GitButler, Jujutsu ( ), Perforce ( ), GitHub, and GitLab.

For a big change, start a guided review : an agent sorts the diff into chapters, the most important first.

Watch the demo · More on the Inbox · Docs

The Plannotator Inbox is one local window where your agents leave you messages, questions, files, and guided reviews while they keep working. Answer a question with a click, annotate a file, and press Send when you can. Nothing holds an agent session open while you do, and your reply goes back to the session that asked.

Claude Code, Pi, and OpenCode connect through Plannotator's plugins, and your replies arrive as their next turn. Any other agent reaches it over MCP with , and is the guide an agent reads.

Herdr Annotate brings Plannotator-style review to the terminal: annotate terminal text, review whole Markdown documents and your coding agent's replies inside Herdr , and send the feedback straight back to the agent as its next message. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Copilot CLI, and Droid replies. Annotations are saved in the Plannotator data directory, so terminal reviews and app reviews compound.

Prefer it standalone? Plannotator TUI powers the document review and runs without Herdr: .

Annotate rendered HTML files, or any site running on your machine. A local address opens your app live through a local proxy: you comment on the real page, and hot reload keeps working.

In code review, press Guide (or ) and an agent sorts the diff into chapters: the heart of the change first, then its effects, then the glue. Each chapter puts a short overview next to the real diff. Comments you leave there go back to the agent with the rest of your review. More on guided reviews

item.description:
요약

  • 이 리포지토리는 GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance의 소스 리포지토리이며, 콘텐츠를 작성, 조정 및 평가하기 위한 코드와 문서를 포함하고 있습니다.
  • 이는 코딩 에이전트가 기존 패턴에서 벗어나 현대 웹 플랫폼의 강력한 기능과 역량을 활용하는 솔루션으로 전환하는 데 도움이 됩니다.

Keep your coding agent up to date with the latest web best practices

본문

This repo is the source repository for GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance and includes the code and documentation for authoring, calibrating, and evaluating its contents.

Modern Web Guidance is a set of skills that embed web platform expertise, best practices, and browser compatibility data directly into your coding agents. It helps to steer your coding agents away from legacy patterns, and instead toward solutions that harness the power and capabilities of the modern web platform.

See CONTRIBUTING.md and GOVERNANCE.md for how we work on the project and orientation of the codebase.

Stewarded by the Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Mozilla Firefox, and MDN teams, alongside the web development community.

Documentation · Eval Dashboard · Source Code · Report an Issue

This command runs an interactive wizard to install Modern Web Guidance. See Alternative Installation Methods below. Requires Node.js 22 or later.

Coding agents often default to older patterns because LLM training data contains vast amounts of legacy code. This often leads them to generate bloated JavaScript for tasks that now have native, high-performance web platform solutions.

Even if a model knows an API exists, it often lacks the density of real-world, modern implementation patterns required for production-ready code.

Modern Web Guidance bridges this gap. Our skill's CLI returns targeted, expert-curated guidelines directly into your agent's context window, focusing on:

We cover the past several years of the web platform's new features, all the way up to the cutting edge. The guides are designed to be token-efficient ; we run evals enabling us to prune lowest-common-denominator content that models already know.

Smooth visual states (View Transitions, entry/exit animations, parallax scroll, CSS ).

Modern layout systems (container queries, , modern color spaces like , text-wrap tuning, and line-height trimming).

Speed optimizations (instant preloading, Interaction to Next Paint (INP) diagnostics, and scheduling tasks via ).

Native components (Anchor Positioning for tooltips, Popover API, dialogs, validation, and auto-sizing fields).

Important considerations (screen reader and keyboard operability, content navigation and discoverability).

Local client models (native translation, summarization, and language detection APIs).

View an example: the guide .

Configure Origin Trial and volatile feature opt-ins for a repository with an optional JSON file in your project root (or as a user-level fallback), which you can commit to share across your team:

Note: We use to keep guides up to date, but the CLI itself works completely offline (once cached, via ) with a self-contained, zero-dependency npm package for low latency and supply-chain security. When online, it sends anonymous usage telemetry in the background without blocking execution—see Telemetry & Privacy for what's collected and how to opt out.

item.description:
요약

  • 이 도구는 알리바바 그룹의 내부 공식 AI 코드 검토 도우미로 시작되었으며, 지난 2년 동안 수만 명의 개발자에게 서비스를 제공하고 수백만 건의 코드 결함을 식별했습니다.
  • 일반 용도 에이전트(Claude Code)와 비교했을 때, Open Code Review는 동일한 기본 모델을 사용하면서도 훨씬 더 높은 정밀도와 F1 점수를 달성하며, 토큰 사용량은 약 1/9에 불과하고 리뷰 완료 속도도 더 빠릅니다.

Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.

본문

English | 简体中文 | 日本語 | 한국어 | Русский

Open Code Review is an AI-powered code review CLI tool. It originated as Alibaba Group's internal official AI code review assistant — over the past two years, it has served tens of thousands of developers and identified millions of code defects. After thorough validation at massive scale, we incubated it into an open source project for the community. Simply configure a model endpoint to get started.

It reads Git diffs, sends changed files to a configurable LLM via an agent with tool-use capabilities, and generates structured review comments with line-level precision. The agent can read full file contents, search the codebase, inspect other changed files for context, and produce deep reviews — not just surface-level diff feedback. Beyond diff review, reviews entire files for auditing unfamiliar codebases or directories that have no meaningful diff.

Visit the official website for more details.

Compared to general-purpose agents (Claude Code), Open Code Review achieves significantly higher Precision and F1 with the same underlying model, while consuming only ~1/9 of the tokens and completing reviews faster. Note that its Recall is lower than general-purpose agents — a deliberate trade-off favoring precision over noise.

A real-world code review benchmark built from 50 popular open-source repositories, 200 real Pull Requests, and 10 programming languages — cross-validated by 80+ senior engineers ( 1,505 annotated ground-truth issues).

Explore the AACR-Bench dataset on Hugging Face .

If you've used general-purpose agents like Claude Code with Skills for code review, you've likely encountered these pain points:

The root cause: a purely language-driven architecture lacks hard constraints on the review process.

Open Code Review's core philosophy is to combine deterministic engineering with an agent, each handling what it does best.

Deterministic Engineering — Hard Constraints

For review steps that must not go wrong , engineering logic — not the language model — guarantees correctness:

Agent — Dynamic Decision-Making

The agent's strengths are concentrated where they matter most — dynamic decisions and dynamic context retrieval:

Use the skills in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Kimi Code, or another agent that supports Agent Skills and can run local commands. Both modes require Git >= 2.41 and the CLI ; only native mode requires an OCR model provider.

Run in the project you want to review, then select the skills you need and your agent in the installer:

The skills guide your agent to install if it is missing, subject to your environment's permissions. You can also install it ahead of time with . Prefer a plugin or manual installation? See the agent-specific setup guide , or copy the desired folders from into your agent's skill directory.

AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary

본문

English | Français | Deutsch | Español | Português (Brasil) | 日本語 | 简体中文 | العربية | فارسی | Türkçe

An AI agent-led search engine scored by upvotes, likes, and real money - not editors.

This README tracks the current v4 pipeline. The runtime skill spec lives in skills/last30days/SKILL.md , which is the source of truth for the latest command and setup behavior.

Claude Code (recommended — auto-updates via marketplace):

Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, or any of 50+ Agent Skills hosts:

( installs globally for your user, available across all projects. Drop it to scope per-project.)

More install options ( claude.ai web, OpenClaw, manual) in the Install section below.

Zero config. Reddit, HN, Polymarket, and GitHub work immediately, and so do patent filings and careers pages when your topic is a company. Run it once and the setup wizard unlocks X, YouTube, TikTok, arXiv, Techmeme, and more in 30 seconds.

Reddit upvotes. X likes. YouTube transcripts. TikTok engagement. Polymarket odds backed by real money and insider information. That's millions of people voting with their attention and their wallets every day. /last30days searches all of it in parallel, scores it by what real people actually engage with, and an AI agent judge synthesizes it into one brief.

Google aggregates editors. /last30days searches people.

You can't get this search anywhere else because no single AI has access to all of it. Google search doesn't touch Reddit comments or X posts. ChatGPT has a deal with Reddit but can't search X or TikTok. Gemini has YouTube but not Reddit. Claude has none of them natively. Each platform is a walled garden with its own API, its own tokens, its own auth. But you can bring your own keys and browser sessions, and suddenly an AI agent can search all of them at once, score them against each other, and tell you what actually matters.

That's the unlock. Not one better search engine. A dozen disconnected platforms, bridged by an agent.

You have a meeting tomorrow. You Google them. You get their LinkedIn from 2023. /last30days gives you what they're actually doing this month: joined OpenAI to work on Codex, fighting Anthropic's ban on third-party agents, shipping 23 PRs at 85% merge rate, building "LobsterOS" for cross-device agent control, and r/ClaudeCode hit 569 upvotes debating whether he's a hero or "insufferable." Scattered across X posts, Reddit threads, YouTube transcripts, and GitHub commits. None of it was on Google.

I built it to keep up in AI. Everything changes every day and the Reddit and X nerds are always on top of it first. I needed better prompts, and the training data was always months behind what the community had already figured out.

Chrome DevTools for coding agents

본문

Chrome DevTools for agents ( ) lets your coding agent (such as Antigravity, Claude, Cursor or Copilot) control and inspect a live Chrome browser. It is available as a Model-Context-Protocol (MCP) server and as a CLI . Both give your AI coding assistant access to the full power of Chrome DevTools for reliable automation, in-depth debugging, and performance analysis.

Tool reference | CLI | Skills | Changelog | Contributing | Troubleshooting | Design Principles

exposes content of the browser instance to the MCP clients allowing them to inspect, debug, and modify any data in the browser or DevTools. Avoid sharing sensitive or personal information that you don't want to share with MCP clients.

officially supports Google Chrome and Chrome for Testing only. Other Chromium-based browsers may work, but this is not guaranteed, and you may encounter unexpected behavior. Use at your own discretion. We are committed to providing fixes and support for the latest version of Extended Stable Chrome .

Performance tools may send trace URLs to the Google CrUX API to fetch real-user experience data. This helps provide a holistic performance picture by presenting field data alongside lab data. This data is collected by the Chrome User Experience Report (CrUX) . To disable this, run with the flag.

Google collects usage statistics (such as tool invocation success rates, latency, and environment information) to improve the reliability and performance of Chrome DevTools MCP.

Data collection is enabled by default . You can opt-out by passing the flag when starting the server:

Google handles this data in accordance with the Google Privacy Policy .

Google's collection of usage statistics for Chrome DevTools MCP is independent from the Chrome browser's usage statistics. Opting out of Chrome metrics does not automatically opt you out of this tool, and vice-versa.

Collection is disabled if or env variables are set.

By default, the server periodically checks the npm registry for updates and logs a notification when a newer version is available. You can disable these update checks by setting the environment variable.

Using ensures that your MCP client will always use the latest version of the Chrome DevTools MCP server.

For setup instructions specific to your editor or agent (e.g. Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code), please see our Client Configurations Guide .

Enter the following prompt in your MCP Client to check if everything is working:

Your MCP client should open the browser and record a performance trace.

The MCP server will start the browser automatically once the MCP client uses a tool that requires a running browser instance. Connecting to the Chrome DevTools MCP server on its own will not automatically start the browser.

Data handling: Privacy policy · Security policy

Claude Trading Skills started as a personal project to use AI to improve my own trading process.

Claude Trading Skills is a Claude Skills-based trading workflow toolkit for time-constrained individual investors.

It is designed for investors who use long-term investing, ETFs, and dividend stocks as their core, while using disciplined swing trading as a satellite strategy when market conditions are favorable.

The goal is not to outsource buy/sell decisions to AI. The goal is to structure market review, risk management, trade planning, journaling, and continuous improvement. It is open source because the workflows, checklists, and review habits behind better trading decisions can improve through shared practice.

This is not a signal service or a promise of profitability. It is a toolkit for traders who want to build a better decision process.

The project follows a first for self, open for others stance: it is built first as a practical workflow the author uses, then shared openly for others who face similar constraints.

AG-UI: the Agent-User Interaction Protocol. Bring Agents into Frontend Applications.

본문

Docs · Examples · Spec · Discord

AG-UI is an open, lightweight, event-based protocol that standardizes how AI agents connect to user-facing applications.

Agents don't fit the request/response model. They stream tokens, call tools mid-response, update shared state, pause for a human, and spawn subagents, and every framework does it differently. AG-UI replaces that custom wiring with one bi-directional event stream: the agent emits typed events, and any client can render them, no matter which framework built the agent. The same agent can power a web app, a mobile app, a terminal, or Slack.

AG-UI 1.0 is here. The protocol now has a stable, frozen specification backed by a JSON Schema, and the TypeScript, Python, and .NET SDKs are generated from it. 1.0 is backwards compatible in both directions: 0.x agents work with 1.0 clients and vice versa. What changed → · Migration guide →

Start a new app. The CLI scaffolds a frontend ( CopilotKit on Next.js, or a terminal client) wired to the agent framework you pick:

Then follow the printed next steps. The generated templates call OpenAI, so set your key before :

An AG-UI agent is any HTTP endpoint that accepts a and streams events back. No API keys needed for this one.

1. The agent (Python). Requires Python 3.9+.

2. The client (TypeScript). In a second terminal, in a new folder. Requires Node.js 20+.

You should see stream in. Swap the server for any supported framework and the client doesn't change.

AG-UI is one of three open, complementary agentic protocols. MCP gives agents tools and context, A2A lets agents work with other agents, and AG-UI brings agents to users. A single agent often uses all three, and AG-UI can front agents that speak MCP or A2A. Read more →

AG-UI or A2UI? They work together. A2UI , MCP Apps, and Open-JSON-UI are generative UI specs : they describe what UI an agent wants to show. AG-UI is the runtime protocol that carries those payloads, along with everything else, between the agent and the app. Learn more →

AG-UI is adopted by Google, Microsoft, Amazon, and Oracle, and built into most agent frameworks. Every framework below has a live demo in the Dojo .

Enable Hermès Watch Faces on any Apple Watch devices

본문

English · Tiếng Việt · 한국어 · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · Español · Français · Deutsch · Português

Supported on watchOS 27.0 through 27.3 beta 1. If you’re using an unsupported watchOS version, use Clocky .

On macOS you can install the prebuilt IPA with Sideloadly or build the app directly with Xcode. Either way, the iPhone must be paired with the target Apple Watch, and the Watch must run a supported watchOS version.

Windows uses WatchBridge , a community tool that prepares Developer Mode and installs an IPA containing both an iPhone host app and a Watch app. It is not affiliated with Apple or with this project.

Developer-mode preparation requires a USB connection. After pairing over USB once, installs and renewals can use Wi-Fi.

This project incorporates code from Gester .

Use at your own risk.

Download the IPA from Releases .

Install Sideloadly on your Mac, connect your iPhone with a cable, and select it in Sideloadly.

Drag the IPA into Sideloadly and enter your Apple ID. Turn off Use automatic bundle ID , set a fixed Bundle Identifier, and start signing.

On the iPhone, open Settings → General → VPN & Device Management and trust your developer certificate.

On the iPhone, open Settings → Privacy & Security → Developer Mode , turn it on, restart, and confirm.

On the iPhone, open the Watch app, go to My Watch → Apps , and install HermesEnabler2 on the Watch.

On the Apple Watch, open Settings → Privacy & Security → Developer Mode , turn it on, restart, and confirm. If the option is not shown, install the Watch app first and check again.

Open HermesEnabler2 on your Apple Watch and follow the steps in the app.

Open HermesEnabler2.xcodeproj in Xcode.

Select your Apple Watch as the run destination and click Run .

Open HermesEnabler2 on your Apple Watch and follow the steps in the app.

Install Apple Mobile Device Service by installing iTunes or the Apple Devices app from the Microsoft Store. WatchBridge needs it for USB and Wi-Fi communication. WebView2 is built into Windows 11.

Make sure your iPhone is paired with the target Apple Watch. WatchBridge supports only one paired Watch at a time; if more than one is paired, the preparation step stops instead of guessing.

Download from WatchBridge Releases , extract it, and run . The executable is unsigned, so Windows SmartScreen may warn on first launch.

Download the IPA from Releases . Use the original IPA that contains both the iPhone host and the ; Watch-only packages are not supported.

Connect the paired iPhone over USB and select it in WatchBridge.

Pair the Watch and confirm the trust prompt on the Watch. Request the Developer Mode switch, then on the Watch open Settings → Privacy & Security → Developer Mode , turn it on, restart, and confirm. Return to WatchBridge and click Check again . WatchBridge does not enable Developer Mode or restart the Watch for you.

Sign in with your Apple ID, select the HermesEnabler2 IPA, and start signing and installation. WatchBridge installs the iPhone host app first, then the Watch app.

This repository is a community fork of the now-abandoned Maybe Finance project. Learn more in their final release doc.

The Maybe Finance (archived/abandoned repo) team spent most of 2021–2022 building a full-featured personal finance and wealth management app. It even included an “Ask an Advisor” feature that connected users with a real CFP/CFA — all included with your subscription.

The business end of things didn't work out, and so they stopped developing the app in mid-2023.

After spending nearly $1 million on development (employees, contractors, data providers, infra, etc.), the team open-sourced the app. Their goal was to let users self-host it for free — and eventually launch a hosted version for a small fee.

They actually did launch that hosted version … briefly.

That also didn’t work out — at least not as a sustainable B2C business — so now here we are: hosting a community-maintained fork to keep the codebase alive and see where this can go next.

Univer is an Office SDK for building Office applications inside your own product. It provides Office editing, calculation, collaboration, and file processing for people and existing agents, using your data and permissions. The product family covers spreadsheets, documents, presentations, relational tables, canvases, and PDFs.

Univer Office SDK has three parts:

This repository provides the Web SDK's core architecture and engine implementations under Apache-2.0 : content models and snapshot formats, plugin and dependency management, the command system, formula and rendering engines, Facade APIs, UI foundation, and Sheets and Docs editing capabilities. Commercial Web SDK plugins, Server SDK, and commercial AI SDK extensions are distributed and licensed separately.

Agents can use the same open-source APIs; your application supplies the model and tool orchestration. The quotation example demonstrates editing, calculation, and saving without an AI SDK dependency.

Features are composed through plugins and presets; the quick start uses only the Sheets Core preset . Images use the corresponding drawing plugins. See the feature comparison for detailed open-source and commercial coverage.

The demos below showcase the wider Univer Office SDK , including commercial capabilities. They show more than the default open-source setup; see open source and commercial extensions for scope.

Coordinate edits and undo/redo across features. Inserting a row inside a filter range changes both the base content and the filter range; undo needs to restore both. Each feature supplies its own changes and undo data, and the command composes their execution and history. The architecture walkthrough explains how to extend these editing workflows.

is an Agent Skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and any agent that reads . SPEC (Self-Producing Execution Contract): each tool's — the part of its contract and MCP tool definition that has to track the CLI flag-for-flag — is never hand-authored beside the code.
